title: Faster English questions
body:
- Reduced the daily question animation minimum to one second, without adding display delay to responses that already take longer.
- Expanded local English templates for this country and hidden country wording, population and area thresholds, and capital-name length.
- Kept full-question matching: extra conditions and incompatible units are not silently discarded.

Polish question templates, game rules, and saved progress are unchanged.
